args.sql:
-- Create the safety_alerts table and insert alerts for robots with High Concern (SIS > 20)

CREATE TABLE safety_alerts (
    robot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL,
    alert_timestamp TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    calculated_sis REAL NOT NULL,
    message TEXT NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO safety_alerts (robot_id, calculated_sis, message)
SELECT 
    ps.effectivenessrobot AS robot_id,
    COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'overloads')::REAL, 0) +
    COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'collisions')::REAL, 0) +
    COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::REAL, 0) +
    COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::REAL, 0) AS calculated_sis,
    'High Safety Concern Detected: SIS > 20. Score: ' || 
    (COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'overloads')::REAL, 0) +
     COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'collisions')::REAL, 0) +
     COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::REAL, 0) +
     COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::REAL, 0)) AS message
FROM performance_and_safety ps
WHERE 
    COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'overloads')::REAL, 0) +
    COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'collisions')::REAL, 0) +
    COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::REAL, 0) +
    COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::REAL, 0) > 20;
